_comment: Characterization snapshot of sleap_roots_analyze.clean_traits_for_analysis (cleanup+validate only) on the raw cylinder input, called with the reader-detected role + trait columns exactly as the qc_clean tool calls it, at qc_clean's CANONICAL default thresholds (max_zeros_per_trait=0.5, max_nans_per_trait=0.2, max_nans_per_sample=0.0, min_samples_per_trait=10). Unlike turface_19's genuinely-raw input, cylinder_raw_data.csv (upstream `traits_11DAG_cleaned_qc_scanner_independent.csv`) was already NaN/zero-filtered by the scanner pipeline before being handed to bloommcp -- so at these thresholds nothing is dropped: samples and traits in == out, zero residual NaNs. Role columns resolve to plant_qr_code/Geno/Rep, distinct from turface_19's Barcode/geno/rep. excluded_from_traits lists the metadata columns bloommcp's role-matching excludes; a further set of non-numeric columns (species_name, crown, lateral, plant_name, etc.) is excluded by upstream sleap_roots_analyze.get_trait_columns's own dtype filtering, the same way Computation.Time.s is handled for turface_19 -- not re-listed here.
_derivation: Recorded via a real fastmcp.Client call to sleap_roots_qc_clean against the running bloommcp dev-stack container (not hand-simulated), 2026-07-22.
